question: What coverings are found above the covering of will and above the awakened covering?
premises: Above the covering of will is the covering named the awakened, attended by the eight Rudras of the directions.
Above the awakened covering is the great covering of observance.
inference: The sequence rises from the awakened covering to the great covering of observance.
plain_english: Above the covering of will is the one called the awakened, attended by the eight Rudras of the directions. Above the awakened covering is the great covering of observance.
